Thought: I need to analyze each statement about ethylene oxide to determine which ones are correct.

A. it is a carcinogenic gas
Ethylene oxide is indeed classified as a carcinogen. It has been linked to various cancers and is classified as a Group 1 carcinogen by the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC).

B. it is a gas less dense than air
Ethylene oxide has a molecular weight of about 44 g/mol, which is higher than air (average molecular weight ~29 g/mol). This means ethylene oxide is actually denser than air, not less dense.

C. it is an extremely flammable gas
Ethylene oxide is highly flammable and can form explosive mixtures with air. It has a wide flammability range and can be ignited easily.

D. it is used for the fumigation of grain stores
Ethylene oxide is used as a fumigant and sterilizing agent. It is used to sterilize medical equipment and spices, but it is not commonly used for grain fumigation (methyl bromide, phosphine, or carbon dioxide are more typical for grain fumigation).

Based on my analysis, statements A and C are correct.
